en.title: Global Disability Accessibility Advances: New EU Digital Standard, NZ Law, and US HUD Updates
en.summary: The European Standard EN 301549 on digital accessibility was published, providing updated guidelines for inclusive technology worldwide. Meanwhile, New Zealand passed its Disability Support Services legislation to enhance support for thousands of people with disabilities, and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development introduced a new deadline for Fair Housing Act accessibility complaints.

en.title: Federal Transit Funding Surges While EU Procurement Rules and Tech Updates Advance Disability Accessibility
en.summary: The Federal Transit Administration allocated $233 million to upgrade rail infrastructure nationwide, and the All Stations Accessibility Program awarded the same amount following a $686 million offer to improve station accessibility. These funding moves coincide with the European Union’s proposed public procurement rules aimed at inclusive infrastructure and Apple’s rollout of iOS 27 accessibility features, including a new Accessibility Reader.

zh-TW.title: 聯邦撥款鐵路無障礙升級 與歐盟採購規則及iOS更新推動無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 聯邦交通管理局撥款2.33億美元用於全國鐵路無障礙升級，所有車站無障礙計畫亦在獲得6.86億美元報價後頒發2.33億美元資金。此期間歐盟提出公共採購新規以促進包容性基礎建設，蘋果則在iOS 27中推出無障礙閱讀器等功能，共同推動無障礙環境的改善。
